thread:
lina: Quick heads-up from the onboarding smoke tests: hitting intermittent 429s and were seeing duplicated items in the sampleapp when a token refresh happens mid-pagination. Repro steps at the bottom.
massimo: ugh. Which SDK and sampleapp branch?
lina: JS sampleapp, branch=onboard-experiments. Default client config (below) + a short burst of parallel page fetchers.
devon: Noted. Probable cause: JSs client throttle lets bursts pile up; auth-refresh then replays requests -> same page served twice -> app merges and you get dupes.
jen: can you paste the config/logs?
lina: Config snippet: 
```js
const client = new Redwood({
  apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY,
  throttle: { windowMs: 800, maxRequests: 20 },
  paginator: { pageSize: 60 }
});
```
Logs from a failing run:
```
[sampleapp] 2026-03-21T10:12:31Z ERROR 429 route=/v1/content id=req-57
[sampleapp] 2026-03-21T10:12:31Z WARN  duplicate page applied pageId="sess-4:p5"
[sampleapp] 2026-03-21T10:12:32Z INFO  auth refresh triggered for worker-7
[sampleapp] 2026-03-21T10:12:32Z INFO  replaying req id=req-57
```
jen: That pageId line is new; what created it?
lina: I prototyped adding a client-generated per-page header: `X-Redwood-Page-Id: <session>:<seq>`; when the client replays the request we can skip applying a page weve already seen. Stops dupes in my runs.
devon: Good short-term mitigation. For parity: Go SDK already had a small dedupe map in paginator. JS/Python currently don't expose a simple hook to dedupe.
massimo: Proposal:
- SDKs should inject a client request-id for paginated requests (header `x-rw-page-id`) by default, but allow opt-out.
- Add an official paginator hook: onPageReceived(pageId, items) -> app can return whether to merge.
- Tighten JS default throttle to `windowMs=300, maxRequests=8` to reduce burst amplification.
- Standardize retry/backoff: base=75ms, jitter, cap=1500ms.
jen: I like that. Also recommend small server-side ephemeral cache for page-ids so server can early-respond with 409/duplicate if it sees same page id within short window.
devon: Implementation notes: client header approach is non-breaking and works with current server. Hook API will need minor semver bump in SDKs. I can draft API prototypes.
ci-bot: devon opened issue devex/1718: "paginator idempotency + sdk parity (page-id header + hook)"
docs-bot: created checklist docs/quickstart/onboarding.md#burst-safety with draft text
massimo: Short-term action items: 1) add sampleapp note about burst-safe settings + example header snippet, 2) small integration test in sampleapp that forces token expiry mid-pagination and asserts no dupes, 3) devon to draft SDK PRs for page-id and hook.
lina: Repro steps I used: run `./scripts/loadtest --workers 18 --page-size 60` for 90s; at t+20s rotate the API key to force token refresh; collect merged output and logs.
jen: I'll add a one-paragraph blurb to onboarding quickstart and a recommended config snippet.
devon: I'll include perf numbers showing cost/latency tradeoffs when changing throttle defaults.
massimo: timeline: aim to land docs + sampleapp test this week, SDK PRs next sprint. Thanks all :rocket:
